description: Seller carries a legal registration identifier (BT-30) alongside its VAT identifier. EN 16931 accepts any of BT-29/BT-30/BT-31 for seller identification (BR-CO-26), so this conforms to the core model; the same document fails under pint-ae, whose identifier_rules.trn requires a bare 15-digit TRN. Replaces en16931-no-identifiers-pass, whose premise -- that the core model requires no seller identifier at all -- is contradicted by BR-CO-26 and BR-S-02.
